column1: Welcome to the PHODA Picture Viewing Task!\n(Photographs of Daily Activities)
Please relax and remain still during the experiment while we record your brain activity.

In this task, you will complete two picture‑viewing blocks.

One block will ask you to rate each picture,
and one block will ask you to simply view them.
The state measure will begin on the following screen.\n\nPlease let us know if you have any remaining questions.
